profileLabel: Rights-protecting on policing and detention, speech-restrictive on disinformation (low-medium confidence)
summary: Misamis Oriental 1st District representative with 174 principal-authored bills. Authored mandatory body-worn cameras for law enforcement, a reintegration system for persons deprived of liberty, penalties for false information causing public harm, an anti-dynasty ban, free period products, an estate tax amnesty extension and a higher individual income tax exemption ceiling.
caveat: Civil-liberties score nets accountability items against a speech penalty and is neutral. Period-products and anti-dynasty bills are single issues in their dimensions and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored universal free access to period products (-2) and a higher individual income tax exemption ceiling (-1), offset by an estate tax amnesty extension (+2). Two issues.
